events.title: National Western Stock Show 2027 Free Grounds Admission Day
events.description: The Stock Show (Jan. 9-24, 2027) offers one free grounds admission day each year (2025: Jan. 14, 2026: Jan. 13, both Tuesdays). 2027 date to confirm on the official page.
